tests.reason: Covers the native Button vertical using scenarios derived from the pinned Kumo tests. It is not a one-for-one adapted upstream suite or a React differential lane.

Covers standalone Checkbox and the compound Group, Item, and Legend family, including native events and refs, controlled and uncontrolled state, form values, label activation, accessibility associations, and validation states.

Covers Collapsible's root, trigger, panel, and default compound APIs, including controlled and uncontrolled state, native event details, disabled behavior, render composition, state callbacks, refs, and panel mounting.

Checks Button, Tooltip, Badge, Meter, SkeletonLine, Empty, Collapsible, Input, InputArea, InputGroup, SensitiveInput, Checkbox, Switch, and Radio through Octane SSR compilation, hydration adoption, and post-hydration interaction; it is not an adapted upstream or React differential lane.
Covers InputArea and Textarea native events and refs, Field associations, controlled and uncontrolled values, min/max row auto-resizing, and cleanup.

Covers InputGroup's complete compound API, container, individual, and hybrid focus modes, inherited state and sizing, native refs and events, aliases, Field integration, and icon and tooltip behavior.
Covers Label, Field, and Input associations, native input events and refs, Base UI-style value details, error precedence, and password-manager attributes.

Covers the generic Radio compound family, accessible naming, native event details, controlled and uncontrolled selection, keyboard navigation, typed values, native form serialization, group states, and card appearance.
Checks generic Radio group and item value inference for string, number, and enum values, including expected type failures.

Covers SensitiveInput's empty, masked, and revealed states, pointer and keyboard operation, controlled and uncontrolled values, native refs and form behavior, Clipboard API and fallback copying, accessible instructions and announcements, validation, and Field integration.
Covers Badge variants and icon forms, Meter labels and values, deterministic and bounded SkeletonLine styles, and Empty variants, contents, successful command copying, and accessible announcements.

Covers standalone Switch and the compound Group, Item, and Legend family, including label activation, native refs and form values, controlled and uncontrolled state, disabled and read-only behavior, transitioning, group naming, and inherited state.
Covers native focus/Escape interaction and custom portal routing for Tooltip; it is not a one-for-one adapted upstream suite or a React differential lane.
Checks package export resolution, declared runtime dependencies, and native source imports; it is not behavioral parity evidence.
Bundles the native root export while externalizing React and ReactCompat specifiers, then rejects either in emitted imports.

Packs the package, installs its tarball into a temporary external consumer, and compiles public Badge, Button, Collapsible, Empty, Meter, SkeletonLine, Tooltip, Label, Field, Input, InputArea, Textarea, InputGroup, SensitiveInput, Checkbox, Switch, and generic Radio usage through root and component-subpath exports.
Checks that every published stylesheet exactly matches its pinned Kumo source by SHA-256; it is not visual parity evidence.
